features.title: Family Hub
features.description: Sets up the Theme Builder sidebar panel and the Family Week Calendar card - nothing on the next few screens is required, and everything here can also be changed later via Configure. Which of these would you like to set up now? Anything left unchecked is skipped below (and can still be turned on any time later, from the card's own Settings or Configure).

users.title: Add users
users.description: Who's in the household? Pick the Home Assistant logins that should be Family Hub members - this is what makes someone show up on the Users/Permissions tabs, the Chores board, and every chore/reward/routine assignment picker. Leave this empty if you'd rather add people later from the card's own Settings > Users tab.

member_profile.title: Set up chores for {member_name}
member_profile.description: A board color for {member_name} (shown on the Chores/Rewards board and calendar), and whether they're included in Chores & Rewards at all - on by default; turn it off for a member who shouldn't get a Chores column or a stars balance (e.g. an adult who just wants the calendar). Both are editable any time from Settings > Users.

chores_features.title: Chores, Rewards & Routines
chores_features.description: A few more optional switches for the Chores board - all off by default, and all reachable later too from the card's own Settings > General > "Chores, Rewards & Routines".

data.goals_in_chores: Show Goals on the Chores board
data.goals_in_rewards: Show Goals on the Rewards page

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.description: Pick any calendars you'd like Family Hub to watch for event reminders (from the calendar card's 'Remind me' field). Leave this empty if you don't want reminders, or aren't sure yet - reachable later via Configure either way.

grocy.title: Grocy (optional)
grocy.description: Connect a self-hosted Grocy instance so the calendar card's Meal Suggestions box can offer 'Add from Grocy' - pulling in a recipe's name plus a link back to view it in Grocy. Leave both fields blank if you don't use Grocy; this can be added later from Configure.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Pick a default target for calendar event reminders (used whenever a calendar doesn't have its own override). Can be left blank and set later from the card's own Settings or Configure > Calendar reminders.

data.default_notify_target: Default target for calendar reminders (e.g. notify.mobile_app_pixel_6a)

digest.title: Daily Digest (optional)
digest.description: Turn on a once-a-day notification summarizing today's events, due reminders, and planned meals - sent whether or not anyone has the dashboard open. Off by default; pick a time and who should receive it if you'd like it on now, or leave it off and turn it on later from the card's Settings or Configure.

dashboard.title: Dashboard (optional)
dashboard.description: Would you like a dedicated Family Hub dashboard - one screen with the calendar card filling the whole view, the same full-dashboard layout this project has always recommended? There's no way for Home Assistant to build it automatically, so saying yes just prepares the exact YAML to paste in on the next screen (Settings > Dashboards > Add Dashboard > Edit in YAML), already filled in with the calendars and to-do lists picked so far.

finish.title: All set

abort.already_configured: Family Hub is already configured. Use Configure to change reminder settings, test a notification, or install an update.

settings.title: Family Hub Settings
settings.description: Most Family Hub settings - theme, per-person notifications, Chores & Rewards options, the screensaver, and more - live inside the Family Hub calendar card itself, not here. Open the dashboard where the card is added, and tap the ⚙️ Settings button in the card's top-right corner. (Calendar reminders, Grocy, and updates are configured from this Configure menu instead - see the other options here.)

grocy.title: Grocy
grocy.description: Optional: connect a self-hosted Grocy instance so the calendar card's Meal Suggestions box can offer 'Add from Grocy' - pulling in a recipe's name plus a link back to view it in Grocy (nothing else is copied in). Leave both fields blank if you don't use Grocy. The API key is stored here, in Family Hub's own integration settings - not in the card's Settings panel.

reminders.title: Calendar reminders
reminders.description: Pick calendars to monitor - Family Hub polls these for events with a reminder set (via the calendar card's 'Remind me' field). Leave calendars empty to turn reminders off. WHO gets notified is now managed per-person from the calendar card's own Settings > Users tab, where each Home Assistant login subscribes to the calendars/reminders/digest they want - the default target and per-calendar overrides below are the OLD household-wide settings, kept only as a record of what this install used to have (they were converted into starting per-user profiles the first time this version ran, and are no longer read by anything).

test_notify.title: Test a notification
test_notify.description: Pick any registered notify target and Family Hub will send it a test message right now - independent of calendars or reminders. Use this to confirm a device is reachable before wiring it into a calendar, or to rule notify delivery in or out if reminders aren't arriving.

restore_backup.title: Backups
restore_backup.description: Restore a saved snapshot, export one to a file, or import a snapshot from a file.

menu_options.export_backup: Export a snapshot to a file
menu_options.import_backup: Import a snapshot from a file

restore_backup_confirm.title: Restore a backup
restore_backup_confirm.description:
Restoring the snapshot from {when}. This will replace your current Users, Permissions, calendars, and other household Settings. A safety snapshot of what you have right now will be taken automatically first.

Would you also like to restore and push out each device's own saved settings (view/layout, screen saver, etc.)? This is off by default - most of the time you only want the household Settings restored, not every tablet's individual display settings rolled back too.

data.push_device_settings: Also restore and push per-device settings

update.title: Update Family Hub
update.description: Install a new family_hub_vN.zip without touching the file system. The current install is backed up automatically before anything is overwritten. Home Assistant needs a restart afterward (Settings > System > Restart) to load the new code - your themes, calendars, and reminders are untouched either way.

restore_backup_pick.title: Restore a backup
restore_backup_pick.description: Family Hub automatically saves a snapshot of your Settings, Permissions, and Device Settings once an hour, keeping the most recent few. Pick one below to restore - a safety snapshot of the current state is always taken first, so this is never a one-way door.

export_backup.title: Export a backup
export_backup.description: Pick a snapshot to save as a file. It's written into Home Assistant's own config folder - download or copy it from there (Samba, SSH, the Studio Code Server or Terminal add-ons, etc.) to keep it somewhere safe or move it to another installation.

import_backup.title: Import a backup
import_backup.description: Upload a backup file previously created with Export a backup (from this install or another one). It's added as a new snapshot you can restore - nothing changes until you pick it from Restore a snapshot afterward.

abort.update_installed: Installed version {version}. Restart Home Assistant (Settings > System > Restart) to finish loading the update.
abort.test_sent: Test notification sent to {target}. If it didn't arrive, check that device/service directly in Developer Tools > Actions, or check its own connectivity/registration (e.g. the Home Assistant Companion app on the phone) - Family Hub only hands off to the service, it doesn't control delivery from there.
abort.no_backups: No Settings-history snapshots exist yet - Family Hub takes the first one automatically within an hour of this install running. If you need to recover sooner, use a full Home Assistant backup instead (Settings > System > Backups).
abort.restore_done: Restored the snapshot from {when}. Per-device settings pushed live: {devices}. A safety snapshot of what you had right before this restore was saved automatically.
abort.export_done: Exported the snapshot from {when} to {path}. Download or copy that file from Home Assistant's config folder to keep it somewhere safe.
abort.import_done: Imported the snapshot from {when}. It's now available to restore from Restore a snapshot - importing it here didn't change anything yet.

error.invalid_target: "{target}" isn't a valid notify target - it should look like notify.mobile_app_something.
error.invalid_backup_file: That file doesn't look like a Family Hub backup export: {error}. Make sure you're uploading a .json file created by Family Hub's own Export a backup step.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.calendars_hint: Tap ⏳ on a calendar to include its events in the countdown banner. Use ➕ Add badge to show a small bubble (like "N", in that calendar's color) on days with events matching a keyword, and optionally hide events matching another keyword. Who gets notified about a calendar's events/reminders is set per-person under the Users tab, not here.
settings.layout_presets_label: Layout ideas — this device only (tap one to fill in the fields below, then Save)
settings.layout_preset_week_desc: One row, all 7 days at a glance — the classic view
settings.layout_preset_portrait_desc: Same 7 days split into 2 rows — bigger text for a tall or portrait-mounted screen
settings.layout_preset_agenda_desc: A scrolling list instead of a grid — best for small screens or a quick glance
settings.layout_preset_two_week_desc: 14 days across 2 rows — plan meals and activities further out
settings.week_button_shows_label: Week button shows — this device only
settings.days_shown_label: Days shown in Week view — this device only (smaller displays: fewer columns)
settings.month_button_shows_label: Month button shows — this device only
settings.show_hours_label: Show hours of the day (timeline) — this device only
settings.grey_out_label: Dim events/reminders that have already passed
settings.grey_out_hint: Today's events dim one by one as they end; any earlier day is dimmed entirely, since the whole day is already over.
settings.fab_position_hint: "Dashboard corner" pins the + button to the bottom-right of the whole screen (today's behavior). "This card's corner" anchors it to the bottom-right of THIS card instead - useful when this card shares a dashboard row/column with other cards, so the button doesn't float off in a corner unrelated to it.
settings.top_bar_style_label: Calendar top bar style — this device only
settings.top_bar_style_hint: Minimal hides the top bar (Settings/Week/Month/Edit Meals/Suggestions/Recipe Box/More) to save space on a small device - Settings moves into the + button's menu instead, right alongside Calendar Entry/Reminder/Meal Suggestion/Recipe. Saved to THIS device/browser only, like the Days shown/Month button settings above - choosing Minimal here won't affect any other Family Hub tablet or screen in the household.
settings.bottom_padding_hint: px - reserves extra space at the bottom of the card (e.g. for a dock, taskbar, or on-screen keyboard)
settings.meal_plan_list_hint: The to-do list the weekly menu is stored on. Leave blank and tap "+ Add list" to create one automatically.
settings.weather_entity_hint: The weather entity each day-column's forecast is pulled from. Leave blank to use the dashboard's own config (or Home Assistant's weather.forecast_home default).
settings.show_meal_plan_month_label: Show meal plan in month view
settings.routines_label: Routines (per-person daily checklists on the Chores board)
settings.routines_hint: One household-wide switch - once on, everyone gets Morning/Afternoon/Night checklist accordions on their own column of the Chores board.
settings.goals_show_on_hint: Chores page adds each person's goals to their own column of the Chores board, with Log Progress/Approve/Send Back actions right there. Rewards page adds a Goals section to the Rewards page alongside the star catalog.
settings.confetti_label: Confetti when a chore is completed
settings.confetti_hint: Pops a quick confetti animation across the screen whenever someone marks a chore done on the Chores board.
settings.danger_zone_hint: Permanently deletes every chore (or goal) regardless of status - open, awaiting approval, or already done. There's no undo. Only visible to real Home Assistant admin accounts.
settings.cycle_countdown_label: Cycle through all upcoming countdown items
settings.cycle_countdown_hint: Add more than one item above (or mark events/reminders "Use as countdown") to see this in action — with only one item there's nothing to cycle through.
settings.digest_hint: Sends one notification each morning summarizing today's events, meals, and due reminders — independent of anyone having the dashboard open. Who gets a digest, and what's in theirs, is set per-person under the Users tab; this just turns the feature on and picks the household's send time.
settings.grocy_hint: Connect Grocy itself under Settings → Devices & Services → Family Hub → Configure → Grocy - the toggles below only control which optional Grocy-powered features show up on the card once it's connected. Everything here is off by default.
settings.track_expiring_hint: Adds an "Expiring Soon" list under the More menu. Whether it's also offered in anyone's Daily Digest is set under the Users tab once this is on.
settings.track_low_stock_hint: Adds a "Low Stock" list under the More menu (products below their own minimum stock amount, with a one-tap button to add them all to the shopping list). Whether it's also offered in anyone's Daily Digest is set under the Users tab once this is on.
settings.screensaver_hint: Shows a full-screen video or live camera feed after the dashboard sits idle for a while - built for a wall-mounted display. The source and idle time below are shared by the whole household; which logins actually see it is controlled per Home Assistant user further down, so a tablet's own login can have it on while a phone's stays off.
settings.video_url_hint: A direct link to a video file, or a path under Home Assistant's own /local/ media folder. Loops muted and silently while showing.
settings.idle_hint: Any tap on the screen dismisses it and starts the countdown over.
settings.disable_recipe_open_label: Disable while a recipe is open
settings.disable_recipe_open_hint: Pauses the idle countdown while a single recipe's detail view is open (Recipe Box or the Grocy recipe viewer) - browsing the recipe list itself still counts as idle.
settings.return_dashboard_label: Return to this dashboard on wake
settings.return_dashboard_hint: Optional. If the screensaver falls asleep here and gets tapped awake, it jumps to this dashboard/view instead of staying on this one - handy if the wall tablet gets left on some other view during the day. Leave blank to just stay put.
settings.device_theme_hint: Overrides the shared theme above for just this device/tablet - every other Family Hub card here (Chores, Rewards, Goals, My Pantry, My Chores) picks it up too, but no other device is affected. Takes effect immediately, with no Save needed.
settings.notify_click_path_hint: Optional. When set, tapping a reminder, event, or Daily Digest push notification opens this Home Assistant dashboard/view instead of just launching the app - use a relative path like /lovelace-family/0 (dashboard + view) or /lovelace/calendar (a view's own path). Applies to every notification this backend sends. Needs the Home Assistant Companion app.
settings.add_member_hint: Add a Home Assistant login to make them part of Family Hub - only people added here show up on this list, on the Permissions tab, and on the Chores board.
settings.profiles_hint: Each Home Assistant login has its own profile here - which calendars they get reminders from, whether they want standalone Reminders, and whether/what they want in the Daily Digest. Tap a person below to set theirs up, or Remove to take them out of Family Hub - nothing about them is deleted, and re-adding them brings everything right back.
settings.no_members_yet: Nobody's been added to Family Hub yet. Use "Add a person" above to get started.
settings.chores_rewards_color_hint: Their color on the Chores board columns and Rewards balances. Leave unset to use the automatically assigned color.
settings.include_chores_rewards_hint: Turn this off to keep them a full Family Hub member (still shown here, on the Permissions tab, and in Routines) without a Chores board column or Rewards balance, and without offering them as a new chore assignee. Handy for a shared login - a wall-mounted tablet, say - that needs Permissions granted but isn't an actual person. Existing chores/rewards history is never affected.
settings.child_account_hint: When they log into Home Assistant and open this card's own Settings, they'll see even less than an ordinary non-admin does - everything a non-admin already can't see, PLUS the whole Users tab (including this very profile). Admin-only, same as Kiosk PIN login and Permissions below - a child can never turn this off for themselves.
settings.no_calendars_added: No calendars added yet - add one under the General tab's Calendars section first.
settings.calendars_tap_hint: Tap a card to subscribe them to reminders from that calendar. Tap the star to make it their primary calendar - that calendar's events follow their own color above instead of its own configured color, everywhere it's shown on the dashboard.
settings.own_calendar_hint: Set this directly here if their calendar isn't already added under the General tab's Calendars section - it'll show up as its own column on the calendar, labeled with their name and their color above, without needing to also add it under Calendars. If it's ALSO added there, this profile's own color/badges win for it.
settings.their_reminders_list_hint: Their own individual Reminders list, separate from the shared family Reminders list. Leave blank and tap "+ Add list" to create one automatically.
settings.their_wishlist_hint: A to-do list just for their own wish list - saving automatically flags it, same as the To-Do Lists card's own Wish List toggle. Leave blank and tap "+ Add list" to create one automatically.
settings.no_other_reminder_lists: Nobody else has their own individual Reminders list set up yet - add one to a person under the General tab's Calendars section first.
settings.other_reminder_lists_hint: Everyone always sees their own list. For anyone else's: "None" keeps it fully out of sight, "Add to calendar" shows it on this person's own calendar (colored with its owner's color) with no push, and "...+ alert" also sends a notification the moment one of its reminders comes due. Anyone subscribed at either level can add new reminders to that list too.
settings.instant_reward_claimed: A reward is claimed (anyone in the household)
settings.instant_chore_approved: One of my chores is approved
settings.instant_chore_rejected: One of my chores is sent back (not approved)
settings.instant_chore_due: One of my chores is due soon (uses that chore's own "remind me" times)
settings.instant_timer_alarm: One of my timers goes off (alarm-style: bypasses silent mode/DND on your phone)
settings.instant_hint: Sent right away, separate from the Daily Digest below - not folded into tomorrow morning's summary.
settings.send_test_digest_hint: Sends what's currently checked above (even if not Saved yet) to this person's notify targets, right now - handy for checking a device actually gets it and previewing today's content.
settings.kiosk_enable_login: Enable logging in as this person on a shared kiosk display
settings.kiosk_login_hint: Once enabled, a 🔒 Login button appears on the Chores and Rewards boards - typing this person's PIN there runs those boards as them for a bit (auto logs out after 45 seconds idle) to claim their own rewards, mark their own chores done, or (if they have approval permission) approve/reject others'.
settings.permissions_admin_hint: Only visible to a Home Assistant admin account - everyone can still do their own chores and claim anything from the Chore Bin regardless of these. Changes here save immediately, not on the Done button below.
settings.kiosk_pin_digits_hint: 4-8 digits. Leave blank and save to clear this person's PIN instead.
settings.screensaver_logins_hint: Check every Home Assistant login that should show the screensaver - everyone else keeps browsing without it, even though Settings itself is shared by the whole household.
settings.screensaver_logins_empty: No other Home Assistant user accounts found besides yours - create one for the wall-mounted device (Settings → People → Users) if you want the screensaver on there but not on your own phone.
settings.screensaver_widgets_hint: Layer weather, a clock, a todo list, or any other Lovelace card on top of the screensaver. The layout is shared by the whole household; below it you can hide individual widgets on just this device.
settings.screensaver_widgets_edit_hint: Drag a widget to move it, drag its bottom-right corner to resize it. This layout is shared by the whole household.
settings.screensaver_widget_gallery_hint: Pick a kind of widget, same as adding a card to a dashboard.
settings.screensaver_widget_type_weather_desc: Current conditions and forecast from a weather entity
settings.screensaver_widget_type_clock_desc: A simple digital clock, no entity needed
settings.screensaver_widget_type_calendar_desc: A month grid for one calendar entity
settings.screensaver_widget_type_camera_desc: A live snapshot from a camera entity
settings.screensaver_widget_type_text_desc: Custom text or Markdown, no entity needed
settings.screensaver_widget_type_custom_desc: Any Lovelace card, written as JSON
settings.screensaver_widget_entity_required: Pick or type an entity first.
settings.screensaver_widget_transparent_label: Transparent background (fill the card, no card background)
settings.screensaver_widget_config_hint: Any Lovelace card's YAML config, written as JSON - the same "type" and other keys you'd use in a dashboard.
settings.screensaver_widget_config_needs_type: Needs at least a "type" field, like a dashboard card's own config.
settings.current_day_first_label: Current day always first — this device only
settings.week_rows_label: Rows shown at once in Week view — this device only
settings.devices_hint: Every dashboard reports its own display settings (Week day count, Current day first, Rows shown in Week view, etc. - see the General tab) here once it's opened at least once. Change a device's values below and hit Push to update it right away - an open dashboard updates instantly, a closed one picks it up the next time it's opened.
settings.devices_empty: No devices have reported in yet - open this dashboard's Settings on another device once to have it show up here.
settings.presets_hint: Save any device's current values above as a named preset, then apply that preset to any other device below.
settings.presets_empty: No presets saved yet - use "Save as preset" under any device above.
settings.holiday_backgrounds_hint: Show a photo on a holiday or special day - normally just behind that day's own column, or check "Expand to full screen" to take over the whole card for just that day, the whole week, or the whole month. If two enabled holidays would both want the screen on the same day, the more specific one wins (a day beats a week, a week beats a month), and if it's still a tie, whichever's own date is closest to today wins. Turn on any of the holidays below, or add a date of your own.
settings.holiday_no_custom_dates: No custom dates yet — add one below.
